question: Who was the last Governor General of British India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Mountbatten.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Mountbatten** was the **last Governor General of British India,** serving from** 1947-1948.**
 
• He was appointed to oversee the** transition of India from British rule **to independence and was instrumental in the** partition of India **and the creation of Pakistan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Hastings** was the Governor General of India from **1813-1823.**
 
• **Lord Auckland** served as Governor General from **1836-1842**.
 
• **Lord Wellesley** served as Governor General from **1798-1805** and was known for his administrative and military reforms.
